title: Review whether learning changed the correct durable artifacts

scenarios: Bootstrap review challenges seven skills and centralized state
Correction is preserved as decision rationale rather than obsolete implementation
Evidence or memory proposes but does not silently redefine intent
spec.passCriteria: Reviewer traces observation, root cause, approved decision, changed owning artifacts and proof; approval scope and remaining uncertainty are explicit
spec.procedure: Review the consequential decision and implementation diff with the check output. Use the learning reference to classify root cause. Record an actual review result as evidence only after review; do not infer it from structural validity.
